source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. The paper prints '2nd INTERIM TEST, 2022 -2023'; examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed academic year (the file name also ends 2023). Groups I and II are printed as (0.5x5 Marks), i.e. 2.5 marks each; they are kept as one entry per group with marks 0 and flagged, because the marks field cannot hold 2.5. Group III (1x5) is split into 1-mark MCQs; the left margin of the scan cuts off the item numbers of III 2-5, which are taken from their order. Section B (2x5 Marks) is 'Any 5' of seven 2-mark questions, so listed marks (5 + 14) differ from the paper total of 20. Rock-type items have no matching chapter in the class 7 list; mixed groups are mapped to weathering-and-soil-formation and rock-only questions have chapter null. Handwritten ticks/marks, the Whatsapp advertisement on page 2 and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
